runs.name: Centrica plc; London CNA, OTC ADS CPYYY at four ordinaries per the F-6 of 2026-06-17, no SEC annual report, GBP under IFRS; UK and Ireland energy supply and services (British Gas, Bord Gais, Hive) with Retail, Optimisation and Infrastructure segments; Grain LNG bought with Energy Capital Partners, a 15% stake in Sizewell C
runs.entry: Price **150.50p** a share, London close 2026-10-16, and **$8.04** an ADS (Yahoo Finance chart API, aggregator, flagged). Shares 4,619,492,850 with voting rights at 2026-09-30 (5,064,902,964 issued less 445,410,114 in treasury), RNS Total Voting Rights of 2026-10-01; `Screens/cover_shares.py` returns not an SEC registrant; the ADS facility (CIK 0001787383, F-6 of 2026-06-17) is four ordinaries per ADS and files no accounts. Sovereign for the earnings currency (GBP) **5.864%**, Bank of England nominal spot gilt curve at 30 years, 2026-10-15, the DMO export refusing the fetch with a captcha; no GBP row in the protocol's table; exchange rate $1.3253, Bank of England XUDLUSS, 2026-10-15. No SEC annual report exists: read from the company's own Annual Reports and Accounts 2018 to 2025 (dates in place of accessions; the 2018 Five Year Summary gives FY2016 and FY2017), the Interim Results to 2026-06-30 (2026-07-23) and the RNS above. Cross-check: 2025 adjusted operating profit GBP 814m in the Five Year Summary equals segment note 4(c) and the CFO's table. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the strategic report, principal risks and the CFO's report, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: Infrastructure decides at 50.4% of 2021 to 2025 adjusted operating profit (Optimisation 30.6%, Retail 20.6%); the trading book belongs to Optimisation, which does not decide, so the text on banks and derivatives does not close the file. **Q2 OUT**: about 98% of Infrastructure's five-year profit came from three assets the filer dates to their end within five years: Spirit Energy (46%, Morecambe to about 2030, "the end of our North Sea gas production"), the share of the old nuclear stations (37%, four of five closing by March 2030) and Rough (14.5%, storage paused, production consent expiring April 2027 with no extension sought); no pricing power (achieved nuclear price GBP 132 to 90/MWh, gas 132p to 107p a therm; windfall levies of 45% on generators and 78% on gas production took the top of the cycle); about GBP 2.9bn net written down on the same assets 2019 to 2025 against about GBP 6.0bn of ten-year profit, half of it from 2022 and 2023; the new parts (Grain LNG, Sizewell C, meters) 2.1% of the part's profit, at contracted (about 9% unlevered on management's figure) or regulated returns. No competitor comparison: the 2025 report names no rival of the deciding part; Ovo, Octopus and EDF (Retail, AR2024) do not file with the SEC and were not read. Ten years of balance sheets read in Step 0: equity GBP 957m (2020) and GBP 1,017m (2022, against GBP 10.2bn of derivative liabilities), retained earnings negative in 2019 and 2022, borrowings GBP 6.3bn to 2.9bn and net cash from 2021, goodwill GBP 2.7bn to 0.5bn. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash all-equity 2021 to 2025 GBP 1,184m, 695m, 2,547m, 908m, (312)m, average GBP 1,004m; maintenance-only central average GBP 1,198m, falling 17.3% a year end to end; value range 137.6p to 457.7p all-equity ($7.29 to $24.26 an ADS), equity-only 172.0p to 414.5p; fair price 189.6p all-equity ($10.05 an ADS), 179.6p equity-only; width 3.62 to one; without 2022 and 2023 (a CONVENTION of the run) fair 148.6p; the construction does not model the dated end of the earning assets, so its top is likely high; not armed, box OUT at Q2. Strongest evidence against the OUT, as the analyst put it: the new assets are contracted or regulated, Sizewell B has a contract to 2055, the computation puts value above the price, and the low-cost comparison was not run, so a reader who takes the commodity paragraph as exclusive would close TOO HARD (WORK) at Q2. Not read: rival accounts, the remuneration report, litigation and stock pay. Commits cbee8479 (template), b4a190af (Step 0, balance sheets, foundations, Q1), 2dd1f81e (Q2), c687e4b3 (the rest). No tracked research file over 200 KB; downloaded reports in the ignored cache folder. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's check 0 problems; the dispatcher's check 41 ids, 10 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; no E-ids; **no citation slip**. check_framework PASS. Contamination declared by the analyst: one filtered listing of `Test Runs/` for CPYYY, centrica or CNA before the copy, returning nothing (a search under the blind rule, declared as a breach); BIPC commit subjects, AYI and ARCB folder names and memory lines, none used. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): the parts rule one level down inside the deciding part; no specific for earning assets the filer dates to closure (Q1, Q2 and Q7 assume a going business); a peak in the middle of the window, which specific (a) does not reach; section C's change for the better against a change of assets; whether the commodity paragraph's low-cost test is exclusive at Q2; no GBP sovereign in the table; the template's competitor row presumes SEC-filing rivals.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (Centrica plc, London CNA, OTC ADS CPYYY at four ordinaries, no SEC annual report, read from its own annual reports 2018 to 2025 and the 2026 interim; Q1 IN, Infrastructure decides at 50.4% of five-year profit; Q2 OUT, about 98% of that part's profit from Spirit Energy, the old nuclear share and Rough, all dated by the filer to end within five years, no pricing power, windfall levies at the top, about GBP 2.9bn of write-downs on the same assets, the new contracted or regulated parts 2.1%; no rival comparison, the report naming none of the deciding part. Computation beneath the stop: value range 137.6p to 457.7p all-equity against 150.50p, fair 189.6p all-equity, 179.6p equity-only, not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: parts inside the deciding part, assets with a dated end, a mid-window peak, a change of assets under section C, the commodity low-cost test as exclusive or not, no GBP sovereign row.)
